rl_reference_selection.basis: Previously completed same-platform 48-case paired report; later endpoints not promoted. No tuning on this new round.
rl_reference_selection.export: Inference-only export, unchanged tensors and inference schema, exact logits/value checked on synthetic inputs; private training metadata excluded.
rl_reference_selection.evaluation_adapter: Add only common ObservationOnlyClient/audit helper; all 36 policy src files and two existing helpers identical to validated source.

evaluation_design.main_contrast: candidate versus frozen derived-silence baseline; RL and original state displayed side by side
evaluation_design.performance_claims: Pilot is development only. No same-case reruns become independent tests. Frozen candidate gets new confirmation and final cases. Stress is separate from random.

expansion_rule.safe: all-clear, accepted certified exit, zero failed clears, physical/public-prefix audits pass
expansion_rule.pilot: mean paired saving > 0 and (95% bootstrap lower > 0 or mean saving >=15s and P90 regression <=120s)
expansion_rule.confirm_and_final: 95% mean saving lower >0 and P95 and max no worse than main comparator; failures retained with fixed penalty

official_scope: Practice only, never formal. Check active collector and practice mode before any session; do not contend with collector. SQLite validation-only, no fitting or counterfactual policy replay.

feedback_envelope.hypothesis: A conservative continuous-feedback one-measurement completion plan can reduce costly additional localization while preserving real clear certificates. Same 23-point family; conservative UB-vs-parent-nominal screening is a heuristic.

candidate_vs_baseline.gate_scope: Only supplied cases; no promotion until final independent and certificate audits

pilot_result.interpretation: This frozen complete-cost envelope policy shows no improvement and fails the predeclared gate; not a theorem against all robust localization planners.

closure.reason: Gate failed: mean and tail cost worsened; 87/87 planned tails executed safely, 86 already certifiable at parent probe. No implementation failure or hidden incomplete-plan success. Further parameter scanning not justified.
closure.delete_scope: Only the newly created research/q3-r3-feedback-envelope branch/worktree after archive push; all start-of-round protected refs retained.

directed_localization.hypothesis: Direction-dependent first-probe-and-nominal-tail transition costs may improve macro task order. Fixed exits per decision, min-directed-edge envelope MST; retain parent legal relocated station layout.

candidate_vs_baseline.gate_scope: Only supplied cases; no promotion until final independent and certificate audits

pilot_result.interpretation: Fails preregistered mean/tail criteria and costs substantially more CPU. Checking bounded-search incumbent omission before concluding this implementation direction.

closure.reason: Both the original pilot and the same-case five-arm ablation fail the whole-episode gate. Explicit incumbent omission diagnosed; isolated repair also failed to beat the primary baseline.
closure.delete_scope: Only this newly-created trial branch/worktree after archive push; do not delete any starting core branch or user changes.

directed_incumbent.hypothesis: 18 of 540 completed finite models omitted a cheaper existing parent route. Seed that feasible route as incumbent without changing cost model, probe family or search budgets. Both model error and search error were observed; require new paired episodes.
directed_incumbent.ablation: Include old_directed on exactly the same new cases as candidate/baseline/original/RL; primary gate remains whole-episode candidate versus derived baseline.
directed_incumbent.review: Independent pure-code review passed; no change to proxies, weights, family or budgets.

candidate_vs_baseline.gate_scope: Only supplied cases; no promotion until final independent and certificate audits

pilot_result.interpretation: Fails preregistered whole-episode mean/tail gate; physical and independent mechanism audits both pass. No confirmation/final opened.

closure.reason: 580 complete models correctly retain and execute a choice bounded by the supplied feasible parent route; zero same-model regressions. Yet mean/P95/max and CPU are worse than the primary baseline. Three matching matrix-budget fallbacks in both directed arms; no unresolved execution defect.
closure.delete_scope: Only this newly-created trial branch/worktree after archive push; do not delete any starting core branch or user changes.

logging_scope: Keep full raw machine records, immutable source/config/model identities and concise decisions; extensive prose optional, do not delay experiments.

protected_version_observations.observation: This preexisting branch name became absent during concurrent workspace activity; this round issued no deletion/reset for it. Preserve its known start version without recreating an externally removed working branch.

outcome.stop_reason: No further reliable improvement found among the main feasible log-backed directions tested; not budget exhaustion and not theoretical optimality.
